title: 第7章 筑基的准备
novel_title: 苟道剑尊：从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
林渊是在后半夜摸回那座破旧小院的。

    刚一进屋，他便紧咬牙关，反手将房门死死闩上。

    确定四周无人跟踪后，他才整个人瘫坐在冰冷的蒲团上，豆大的汗珠混着血水不断从额头滴出。

    “咳咳……”

    林渊压抑着嗓子，剧烈地咳嗽了几声，又呕出一口暗红色的瘀血。

    青竹蛇的突袭固然凶险，但真正让他受创的，是强行催动未曾祭炼的金鳞盾所带来的反噬。

    二阶法器那狂暴的灵力如同一头蛮牛，在他那炼气期的脆弱经脉中横冲直撞，若非他修炼的是以稳固见长的《玄金诀》，加之最后关头果断撤力，这条右臂怕是当场就要废掉。

    顾不得心疼，林渊从怀中摸出一个白瓷小瓶，倒出一粒散发着淡淡清香的回气丹吞下。

    随着丹药化开，一缕温润的药力开始缓缓修补他受损的经脉，体内那干涸窒息的灵力终于有了一丝流转的迹象。

    “前山那些狗娘养的嫡系修士已经开始变本加厉剥削他了，陈刘两家的密谋也已经定下。”

    林渊靠在墙壁上，自嘲地笑了一声，“七天……不，扣除今夜，满打满算也只有六天时间。一旦七日大限一到，陈、刘两家联手破阵，整个林家大院将沦为屠场。我若不想沦为林崇山的替罪羊，或者陈家刀下的冤魂，就必须在这六天之内，踏入筑基期！”

    炼气期与筑基期，两字之差，却是仙凡之隔。

    炼气期修士，寿元不过百余载，灵力仍是气态，施展法术需掐诀念咒，笨重且威力有限。

    可一旦筑基成功，体内灵力液化，不仅寿元暴增至两百余年，更可御器飞行，神识外放，战力何止提升了十倍？

    若是能成筑基，哪怕林家大门当场被砸烂，他也有足够的底气在乱军之中飘然远遁。

    可要在林家大院里闭关突破，那纯粹是自寻死路。

    突破筑基时，气态灵力转化为液态，会在方圆数里内引发剧烈的灵气漩涡。

    以林崇山如今那如同疯狗般的搜查力度，恐怕灵气刚刚出现波动的瞬间，他就会带着嫡系执法队破门而入，将自己连皮带骨给生吞了。

    “林家大院留不得，前山和后山的普通闭关室也都是活靶子。”
content_en:
Lin Yuan returned to the dilapidated courtyard in the middle of the night.

    As soon as he entered the house, he gritted his teeth and bolted the door tightly with his backhand.

    After making sure that no one was following him, he slumped down on the cold futon, large beads of sweat mixed with blood dripping from his forehead.

    "Ahem..."

    Lin Yuan suppressed his throat, coughed violently several times, and vomited out another mouthful of dark red blood.

    The Green Bamboo Snake's surprise attack was certainly dangerous, but what really hurt him was the backlash caused by forcibly activating the unforged golden scale shield.

    The violent spiritual power of the second-level magic weapon was like a wild bull, rushing through his fragile meridians in the Qi refining stage. If he hadn't practiced the "Xuanjin Jue" which is known for its stability, and he decisively withdrew his strength at the last moment, this right arm would have been destroyed on the spot.

    Regardless of his heartache, Lin Yuan took out a small white porcelain bottle from his arms, poured out a rejuvenating pill that exuded a light fragrance and swallowed it.

    As the elixir dissolved, a wisp of warm medicinal power began to slowly repair his damaged meridians, and the dry and suffocating spiritual power in his body finally showed signs of flowing.

    "Those son-of-a-bitch monks in Qianshan have begun to intensify their efforts to exploit him, and the plot of the Chen and Liu families has also been decided."

    Lin Yuan leaned against the wall and laughed to himself, "Seven days... no, excluding tonight, there are only six days left. Once the seven days are up, the Chen and Liu families will join forces to break the formation, and the entire Lin family compound will become a slaughterhouse. If I don't want to become Lin Chongshan's scapegoat, or the wronged soul of the Chen family, I must enter the foundation building period within these six days!"

    The difference between the Qi refining stage and the foundation building stage is the difference between immortals and mortals.

    The lifespan of a monk in the Qi refining stage is no more than a hundred years, and his spiritual power is still in the gaseous state. To cast spells, he needs to make hand gestures and recite incantations, which is cumbersome and has limited power.

    But once the foundation is successfully built and the spiritual power in the body is liquefied, not only will the lifespan increase to more than two hundred years, but also the ability to fly with weapons, release spiritual consciousness, and increase the combat power by more than ten times?

    If he could successfully build the foundation, even if the Lin family's door was smashed on the spot, he would still have enough confidence to escape among the rebels.

    But if you want to break through in seclusion in the Lin family compound, it is simply asking for death.

    When breaking through the foundation building, the gaseous spiritual energy is converted into a liquid state, which will trigger a violent spiritual energy vortex within several miles.

    With Lin Chongshan's current search intensity like a mad dog, I am afraid that the moment his spiritual energy begins to fluctuate, he will lead his direct law enforcement team to break in and eat him alive, including his skin and bones.

    "We can't stay in the Lin family compound, and the ordinary retreat rooms in the front and back mountains are also living targets."
